summary: The filing is an 8-K by KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC, reporting the transactional net asset value per share for eight share classes as of July 31, 2026, in a routine disclosure. Values range from $30.78 to $36.93. No transaction, strategic action, or structural change is involved; it is a periodic NAV update required for a non-traded investment vehicle. The filing includes an exhibit with valuation methodology. This is not a special situation, as it is a standard operational disclosure.
